segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text:
Hi Dana,

Attached is the renewal outline for 42 seats, 12-month term starting May 1. It keeps the current support tier and adds the reporting module.

Total is $31,752 annually, invoiced on signature with net 30 terms.

Mark

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text:
Mark,

Thanks. We’re good on the 42 seats and May 1 start. The annual total is a little high for what I have approved. I’m at $29k even for the year.

Dana

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text:
Dana,

Understood. If we keep the reporting module but move the admin training to a recorded session, I can get close.

Would $29,484 work? Same 42 seats, same May 1 start, annual invoice.

Mark

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text:
That should work. Can you confirm there’s no change to data retention or the standard support response time?

Dana

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text:
Correct, no change there. Retention stays at 24 months and support stays next-business-day for standard tickets, four-hour target for urgent.

Mark

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text:
Okay. Procurement will ask why the order form still shows $31,752. The number you sent me separately is fine for approval on our side if you can get the final doc lined up after.

Dana

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text:
Yes, that’s fine. Use $29,484 for the approval packet. I’ll send the cleaned-up order form before you route for signature.

Mark

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text:
Sounds good. Please make the billing contact ap@northlakefoods.com and list the PO as required. We should have the PO by April 24.

Dana

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text:
Will do. I’ll include the billing contact and PO-required language. Once the PO is in, we can target May 1 go-live without any gap in access.

Mark
